title_sq: MIHAL GRAMENO, SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1+2 ME KUZHINE TE VECUAR
description_sq:
Shume prane shkolles Mihal Grameno, shesim 2+1+2.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje pallati ekzistues dhe nga 3+1 eshte i pershtatur ne 2+1 me 2 banjo dhe kuzhine te vecuar dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me dalje ne ballkon, nje kuzhine si dhome me vete, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualetin e saj te dedikuar, nje dhome gjumi femijesh dhe nje tualet te pergjithshem.
Vlen per tu theksuar qe planimetria eshte perfekte dhe te dy tualetet jane me dritate dhe te bollshem. Apartamenti eshte i orientuar nga Jugu cka mundeson diell gjate gjithe dites.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes me te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode duke marre parasysh qe ka kopesht femijesh dhe shkolle shume prane.
title_en: MIHAL GRAMENO, APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 WITH OLD KITCHEN
description_en: Very close to Mihal Grameno school, 2+1+2 for sale. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing building and is adapted from 3+1 to 2+1 with 2 bathrooms and a separate kitchen and is organized in a living room with access to the balcony, a kitchen as a separate room, a matrimonial bedroom with its dedicated toilet, a children's bedroom and a general toilet. It is worth noting that the floor plan is perfect and both toilets are bright and spacious. The apartment is oriented to the South, which allows the sun throughout the day. The area in which it is located is one of the best areas of Tirana with all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, considering that there is a kindergarten and a school very close by.
